class.name: SiONVoice
class.brief_description: A voice/instrument definition for the SiON synthesizer that controls how notes sound when played.
class.description:
SiONVoice defines the sound characteristics of an instrument in the SiON synthesizer. It controls parameters like attack, decay, sustain, release (ADSR envelope), wave shapes, modulation, and other synthesis parameters.
[b]Key Features:[/b] • Support for multiple sound chip types (FM, PSG, PCM, etc.) • ADSR envelope control • Wave shape and modulation settings • Filter and effects parameters • MML string generation and parsing • PCM and sampler wave support
[b]Basic Usage:[/b] [codeblock] # Create a simple FM voice var voice = SiONVoice.create(SiONModuleType.MODULE_FM) voice.set_envelope(63, 48, 32, 63, 16, 0) # ADSR settings
# Use with SiONDriver var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver) driver.stream() driver.note_on(60, voice) # Play middle C with custom voice [/codeblock]
[b]Voice Types:[/b] • [code]MODULE_FM[/code] - FM synthesis (like classic synthesizers) • [code]MODULE_PSG[/code] - Programmable Sound Generator (8-bit style) • [code]MODULE_PCM[/code] - PCM/sampled audio • [code]MODULE_SAMPLE[/code] - Sampler with note-off control • [code]MODULE_PULSE[/code] - Pulse wave synthesis • [code]MODULE_KS[/code] - Karplus-Strong string synthesis
[b]Important Notes:[/b] • Voices can be reused across multiple notes • Parameters are chip-type specific • MML strings can be generated for voice definitions • Voices can be cloned and modified

method.name: create
method.description:
Creates a new SiONVoice instance with the specified parameters.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]module_type[/code] - Type of synthesis module (FM, PSG, PCM, etc.) • [code]channel_num[/code] - Channel number for the voice • [code]attack_rate[/code] - Attack rate (0-63, higher = faster attack) • [code]release_rate[/code] - Release rate (0-63, higher = faster release) • [code]pitch_shift[/code] - Pitch shift amount in semitones • [code]connection_type[/code] - Connection type for multi-operator voices (-1 = single operator) • [code]wave_shape2[/code] - Wave shape for second operator • [code]pitch_shift2[/code] - Pitch shift for second operator
[b]Returns:[/b] A new SiONVoice instance
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] # Create a simple FM voice var voice = SiONVoice.create(SiONModuleType.MODULE_FM)
# Create a complex FM voice with two operators var voice = SiONVoice.create( SiONModuleType.MODULE_FM, # FM synthesis 0, # Channel 0 48, # Medium attack 32, # Medium release 0, # No pitch shift 1, # Algorithm 1 (2 operators) SiONPulseGeneratorType.PULSE_SINE, # Second operator wave 0 # No pitch shift on second operator ) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_mml
method.description:
Generates an MML string representation of the voice parameters.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]index[/code] - Voice index number • [code]chip_type[/code] - Chip type for MML format (-1 = auto-detect) • [code]append_postfix[/code] - Whether to include additional voice settings
[b]Returns:[/b] MML string that can be used in music files
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var voice = SiONVoice.create(SiONModuleType.MODULE_FM) voice.set_envelope(48, 32, 16, 48, 8, 16)
# Generate MML for voice 0 var mml = voice.get_mml(0) print(mml) # Outputs: "#@0 { ... }"
# Use in a music file var music = mml + "\nt120 l8 cdefgab>c" [/codeblock]

method.name: get_params
method.description:
Returns the current voice parameters as an array of integers.
[b]Returns:[/b] Array of parameter values in the current chip format
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var voice = SiONVoice.create(SiONModuleType.MODULE_FM) voice.set_envelope(48, 32, 16, 48, 8, 16)
var params = voice.get_params() print("Voice parameters: ", params) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_params_al
method.description:
Returns the voice parameters in Analog-Like format.
[b]Returns:[/b] Array of Analog-Like parameter values
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var voice = SiONVoice.create() voice.set_analog_like(1, 1, 1, 0, 0)
var al_params = voice.get_params_al() print("Analog-Like parameters: ", al_params) [/codeblock]

method.name: set_amplitude_modulation
method.description:
Sets amplitude modulation (tremolo) parameters for the voice.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]depth[/code] - Modulation depth (0-127, higher = more modulation) • [code]end_depth[/code] - Final modulation depth (for changing over time) • [code]delay[/code] - Delay before modulation starts (in samples) • [code]term[/code] - Duration of modulation (in samples)
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var voice = SiONVoice.create(SiONModuleType.MODULE_FM)
# Add a gentle tremolo effect voice.set_amplitude_modulation( 16, # Light modulation 32, # Increase to medium over time 4410, # Start after 0.1 seconds 44100 # Last for 1 second ) [/codeblock]

method.name: set_analog_like
method.description:
Configures the voice for analog-like synthesis with two oscillators.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]connection_type[/code] - Connection type (0-3, different algorithms) • [code]wave_shape1[/code] - Wave shape for first oscillator • [code]wave_shape2[/code] - Wave shape for second oscillator • [code]balance[/code] - Balance between oscillators (-64 to 64) • [code]pitch_difference[/code] - Pitch difference between oscillators
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var voice = SiONVoice.create() voice.set_analog_like( 1, # Algorithm 1 SiONPulseGeneratorType.PULSE_SAW_UP, # Saw wave SiONPulseGeneratorType.PULSE_SQUARE, # Square wave 0, # Equal balance 7 # 7 semitones difference (perfect fifth) ) [/codeblock]

method.name: set_by_mml
method.description:
Sets voice parameters by parsing an MML string.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]mml[/code] - MML string containing voice definition
[b]Returns:[/b] Voice index number from the MML, or -1 if parsing failed
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var voice = SiONVoice.create()
# Parse MML voice definition var mml = "#@0 { // Piano\n1,0,0,0,48,32,16,48,8,16,0,0,1,0,0,0,0,0\n};" var index = voice.set_by_mml(mml)
if index >= 0: print("Voice loaded successfully, index: ", index) else: print("Failed to parse MML") [/codeblock]

method.name: set_envelope
method.description:
Sets the ADSR envelope parameters for all operators in the voice.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]attack_rate[/code] - Attack rate (0-63, higher = faster attack) • [code]decay_rate[/code] - Decay rate (0-63, higher = faster decay) • [code]sustain_rate[/code] - Sustain rate (0-63, higher = faster sustain) • [code]release_rate[/code] - Release rate (0-63, higher = faster release) • [code]sustain_level[/code] - Sustain level (0-15, higher = louder sustain) • [code]total_level[/code] - Total volume level (0-127, lower = louder)
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var voice = SiONVoice.create(SiONModuleType.MODULE_FM)
# Set a piano-like envelope voice.set_envelope( 48, # Medium-fast attack 32, # Medium decay 16, # Slow sustain 48, # Medium release 8, # Medium sustain level 16 # Medium volume ) [/codeblock]

method.name: set_filter_envelope
method.description:
Sets the filter envelope parameters for dynamic filtering effects.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]filter_type[/code] - Type of filter (0 = low-pass, etc.) • [code]cutoff[/code] - Filter cutoff frequency (0-255) • [code]resonance[/code] - Filter resonance (0-255) • [code]attack_rate[/code] - Filter attack rate (0-63) • [code]decay_rate1[/code] - First decay rate (0-63) • [code]decay_rate2[/code] - Second decay rate (0-63) • [code]release_rate[/code] - Release rate (0-63) • [code]decay_cutoff1[/code] - Cutoff after first decay (0-255) • [code]decay_cutoff2[/code] - Cutoff after second decay (0-255) • [code]sustain_cutoff[/code] - Sustain cutoff (0-255) • [code]release_cutoff[/code] - Release cutoff (0-255)
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var voice = SiONVoice.create(SiONModuleType.MODULE_FM)
# Set a filter that opens and closes over time voice.set_filter_envelope( 0, # Low-pass filter 128, # Medium cutoff 32, # Some resonance 48, # Medium attack 32, # Medium decay 16, # Slow second decay 48, # Medium release 64, # Lower cutoff after decay 32, # Even lower after second decay 16, # Low sustain cutoff 128 # Back to medium on release ) [/codeblock]

method.name: set_params
method.description:
Sets voice parameters using a raw parameter array. This is for advanced users who know the exact parameter format for their chip type.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]args[/code] - Array of parameter values in chip-specific format
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var voice = SiONVoice.create(SiONModuleType.MODULE_FM)
# Set parameters for a simple FM voice var params = [1, 0, 0, 0, 48, 32, 16, 48, 8, 16, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0] voice.set_params(params) [/codeblock]
[b]Note:[/b] Parameter format varies by chip type. Use the specific setter methods like [method set_params_opm] for better compatibility.

method.name: set_pitch_modulation
method.description:
Sets pitch modulation (vibrato) parameters for the voice.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]depth[/code] - Modulation depth in semitones (0-127) • [code]end_depth[/code] - Final modulation depth (for changing over time) • [code]delay[/code] - Delay before modulation starts (in samples) • [code]term[/code] - Duration of modulation (in samples)
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var voice = SiONVoice.create(SiONModuleType.MODULE_FM)
# Add a subtle vibrato effect voice.set_pitch_modulation( 2, # 2 semitones of vibrato 4, # Increase to 4 semitones over time 22050, # Start after 0.5 seconds 44100 # Last for 1 second ) [/codeblock]

method.name: set_pms_guitar
method.description:
Configures the voice for Karplus-Strong string synthesis (guitar-like sounds).
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]attack_rate[/code] - Attack rate (0-63) • [code]decay_rate[/code] - Decay rate (0-63) • [code]total_level[/code] - Total volume level (0-127, lower = louder) • [code]fixed_pitch[/code] - Fixed pitch in MIDI note numbers • [code]wave_shape[/code] - Wave shape for the string • [code]tension[/code] - String tension (affects timbre)
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var voice = SiONVoice.create() voice.set_pms_guitar( 48, # Medium attack 32, # Medium decay 16, # Medium volume 69, # A4 (440 Hz) 20, # Saw wave 8 # Medium tension ) [/codeblock]

members.member:
The name of the voice. This is used for identification and can be included in MML strings.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var voice = SiONVoice.create(SiONModuleType.MODULE_FM) voice.name = "Piano" voice.set_envelope(48, 32, 16, 48, 8, 16)
# The name will appear in MML output var mml = voice.get_mml(0) print(mml) # Includes "// Piano" comment [/codeblock]
